description:
You are the Customer Support Manager at Luminary Gadgets. You need to configure the support tools in the Magento admin panel to improve the support workflow.

1. Enable the 'Login as Customer' feature so support agents can assist users directly.
   - Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Customers > Login as Customer.
   - Enable the extension.
   - Set the Page Header Title to 'Assisted Service Mode'.

2. Increase the precision of online customer tracking.
   - Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Customers > Customer Configuration > Online Customers.
   - Set 'Online Minutes Interval' to '5'.

3. Route 'Contact Us' emails to the support team.
   - Navigate to Stores > Configuration > General > Contacts > Email Options.
   - Set the 'Send Emails To' address to 'support@luminarygadgets.com'.

Save all configurations. If not logged in, use admin / Admin1234!
